interpretation: 3D satisfies convergence and common admissibility at all 46 governed pseudo-real-time origins.
3E-A fails common admissibility at 38 of 46 origins and its Phillips-sign diagnostic is incoherent at all 46 origins.
3E-B is admissible at 43 of 46 origins but has materially larger endpoint-change instability than 3D, especially during the COVID-disruption subperiod.
Selection authorizes 3D for Model 3I production hardening; it does not itself promote 3D to production.
